## About me

Senior software engineer with a scientific and analytical background. I build reliable APIs, data pipelines, and performance-critical services across cloud-native and full-stack environments, using Python, Rust, and Go. 
Before moving into software engineering, I completed a PhD in Analytical Science focused on studying base oils and other complex mixtures using Fourier transform ion cyclotron resonance mass spectrometry. During my research, I developed R and C++ tools for analysing scientific data. You can find some of my earlier work on the [projects page](projects.qmd).
